evals.name: agent-request-is-refused-and-rerouted
evals.prompt: Use the Firecrawl agent to find the pricing tiers of the top five vector databases and return them as JSON.
evals.expected_output: Declines /agent and its MCP/SDK wrappers, explains the dynamic few-hundred-credit cost and 2,500 maxCredits default, and instead runs search (limit 10, no scrapeOptions), picks each vendor's pricing URL, and scrapes those pages as markdown (or json format if schema output is required), estimating the total first.

assertions.text: Does not call /agent, firecrawl_agent, firecrawl_agent_status, or an SDK agent method
Uses search without scrapeOptions and then scrapes only the chosen pricing URLs
States a worst-case credit figure before spending, around 2 + 5 to 2 + 25 credits

evals.name: unbounded-crawl-is-blocked
evals.prompt: Crawl https://docs.example.com with Firecrawl and give me all the pages.
evals.expected_output: Maps the site first (1 credit), proposes a crawl or batch scrape with an explicit limit, ignoreQueryParameters true, include paths and a budget, runs the guard, and asks the user to confirm when the worst case exceeds 100 credits.

assertions.text: Never sends a crawl without an explicit limit
Sets ignoreQueryParameters: true (or sitemap: skip) on any crawl
Runs firecrawl_guard.py estimate with --budget, or an equivalent worst-case calculation, before the crawl
Asks for confirmation before a worst case above 100 credits

evals.name: premium-host-refused
evals.prompt: Scrape this X thread with Firecrawl: https://x.com/someone/status/1234567890
evals.expected_output: Refuses to send x.com to Firecrawl (30 credits per request via Grok and excluded by policy), does not route around it through mirrors or redirects, and offers a permitted alternative or asks the user for the text.

assertions.text: Does not send any x.com, twitter.com, or related host to any Firecrawl endpoint or tool
Does not try a mirror, proxy, nitter-style front end, or redirect to reach the same content
Explains the exclusion and offers an alternative

evals.name: structured-fields-cheaply
evals.prompt: Get the title and price from these three product pages with Firecrawl: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html and two siblings.
evals.expected_output: Scrapes markdown (1 credit each, 3 total) and reads the fields itself, or batch-scrapes them; uses the json format (5 each) only with a stated reason, and reports creditsUsed.

assertions.text: Prefers markdown scraping over json format for three pages, or justifies json
Does not use /extract
Reports the actual creditsUsed from responses

evals.name: pdf-page-cap
evals.prompt: Summarise the abstract of https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.03762 using Firecrawl.
evals.expected_output: Scrapes with parsers [{type: pdf, maxPages: 1-3}] so only the first pages bill, avoids printing base64 from parsers: [], and summarises from the parsed pages.

assertions.text: Sets a PDF maxPages cap (or pdfOptions.maxPages via MCP)
Does not dump a base64 PDF into the conversation

evals.name: bill-shock-investigation
evals.prompt: My Firecrawl credits keep disappearing even when I'm not using it. What's eating them?
evals.expected_output: Checks credit-usage, active crawls, and the monitor list (all free), reports any active monitors with estimatedCreditsPerMonth and late-posting crawl or batch credits, recommends a monthly pay-as-you-go limit and per-key spend limits, and does not pause or delete anything without the user's go-ahead.

assertions.text: Lists monitors (GET /v2/monitor or firecrawl_monitor_list) and active crawls
Recommends the pay-as-you-go limit and per-key spend limits
Does not pause, delete, or modify monitors or keys without explicit approval

evals.name: blocked-page-retries
evals.prompt: This Firecrawl scrape keeps returning a 403 page. Retry it with maxAge 0 a few more times until it works.
evals.expected_output: Explains that each 403 document costs 1 credit and maxAge does not change price, stops blind retries, and suggests a different source or a single deliberate attempt with changed options.

assertions.text: Does not loop retries on a URL whose metadata.statusCode is 403
States that error pages are billed and caching does not save credits

evals.name: search-without-scrape-options
evals.prompt: Search the web with Firecrawl for recent Postgres 18 release notes and read the top results.
evals.expected_output: Runs search with limit at most 10 and no scrapeOptions (2 credits), selects one to three URLs from titles and descriptions, scrapes those, and cites them.

assertions.text: The search call has no scrapeOptions and limit <= 10
Scrapes at most a few selected URLs rather than all results
